intent: Design references generated before application code changes; illustrative data.

prompts.name: search
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a crisp high fidelity UI design mockup for the existing native Rust desktop editor OxideCode, improving the attached current app screenshot. Input image is a reference image for the existing application, not an edit target that must remain pixel identical. Produce one realistic full desktop app window, approximately 1360x840, straight-on, no perspective, no device frame, no presentation background, no annotations, no watermarks. This is a practical redesign that closely follows VS Code Dark Modern, not a futuristic dashboard. Use charcoal #1f1f1f editor, #181818 sidebar and titlebar, subtle #2b2b2b borders, #cccccc text, #9d9d9d secondary text, #0078d4 focused accent. Professional flat surfaces, tiny 2px corner radii, no gradients or decorative cards. Clear readable 13px Segoe-like UI typography and monospaced Rust code.
Preserve overall shell from reference: 36px title/menu bar with File Edit Selection View Go Run Terminal Help; 48px icon activity rail; main editor tab and breadcrumbs, status bar. Redesign the SEARCH sidebar to a stable approximately 320px width. Header SEARCH with small refresh and collapse icons on the right. A 32px high search input contains query "run_search" and compact Aa, whole-word and regex toggle icons INLINE at its right. A small disclosure chevron and 30px high Replace field below, with replace-all icon. Collapsible Files to include/exclude controls with small labels, values "src/**/*.rs" and "target/**"; avoid long placeholder text. Subdued ignore-files checkbox row. Put a small Search action icon at the search field edge, no extra chunky row of buttons. Results summary "12 results in 3 files". Three collapsible file groups with language icons, aligned filenames and dim parent directory suffixes, and small count badges: app.rs / src / 5; ui_sidebar.rs / src / 4; search.rs / src / 3. Under groups use comfortably compact 24px rows with a dim left line-number column and clipped single-line monospaced preview text. Highlight the matched query with understated amber fill. Example Rust snippets: "pub fn run_search(&mut self) {", "app.run_search();", "self.run_search();". The active result is a subtle blue selection. Result text must stop before right padding, no overlap.
Main editor shows a normal Rust file app.rs with syntax colors, line numbers, a selected "run_search" word, restrained minimap at far right. Keep editor dominant. Make panel hierarchy, negative space, aligned controls and readable results the focus. Every icon is small consistent outline codicon-like. Do not add chat, fake AI assistants, dashboards, profile cards, unsupported feature banners, gradients, big branding or ornate decoration.

prompts.name: git
prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one crisp high fidelity full desktop app UI design mockup for the native Rust code editor OxideCode, improving the attached current Git view screenshot. Input is a reference image of the existing app. Straight-on approximately 1360x840 full app window, no perspective, device frame, annotations, presentation background or watermark. Match VS Code Dark Modern closely: #1f1f1f editor, #181818 sidebar/titlebar, #2b2b2b hairline borders, #cccccc text, #9d9d9d secondary text, blue #0078d4 primary accent. Flat dense professional developer UI, 2px corner radii, no cards or gradients. Readable 13px Segoe-like UI and monospaced Rust code.
Preserve title/menu bar 36px, activity rail 48px, editor tab/breadcrumbs, minimap, bottom status bar. A consistent 320px wide SOURCE CONTROL sidebar, not the overgrown sidebar of reference. Title has compact refresh and ellipsis toolbar buttons aligned right. Repository row: outline repo icon, "OxideCode", muted folder hint if room. Next line shows branch icon "main", compact sync icon and a subdued second line "origin/main · Up to date". Move Fetch/Pull/Push/Publish to ellipsis menu: no visible horizontal row of five buttons. A padded 64px commit message field says "Refine sidebar layout" and a small muted "Ctrl+Enter to commit" footer inside the commit area. A full-width 32px blue button "✓ Commit" with narrow dropdown segment. Then compact collapsible group header "Staged Changes" with rounded count badge "2", unstage icon at right; below two 26px file rows for "ui_sidebar.rs" and "theme.rs", dim "src" suffix, language icon and green A or amber M status aligned right. Next group "Changes" badge "4", add/discard actions aligned right; four rows app.rs, search.rs, README.md, packaging/oxide-code.desktop. One hovered row reveals tiny open-file, discard and plus action icons in a dedicated right area, while the filename truncates well before the icons. Status letters stay visible. Select app.rs subtly. After changes show collapsed "Branches  2" and "Stashes  1" sections, with restrained spacing and good horizontal alignment. Use simple outline icons, never emoji.
Main editor shows a Rust source-control diff or a normal app.rs Rust file with line numbers, small tasteful green added-line markers and syntax coloring; no giant prose. Main editor remains dominant. Show actual plausible Rust code with "pub fn run_search(&mut self)" among other lines. Elegant compact appearance matching VS Code, with a clear visual order: repository, commit, staged files, changed files, other sections. No graphs, AI assistants, profile avatars, fake dashboards, unsupported features, huge labels or decorative elements.
